meta.description: The smallest possible tool call check: one tool, no required arguments, one obvious reason to call it. This exists to disambiguate function_call_single. That case asks the model to both decide to call a tool and extract 'Zurich, Switzerland' from the prompt, so a failure there does not say which half broke. This case takes argument extraction out of the picture, so a failure here means structured tool calling itself is not working, whether that is the chat template, the tool parser or the serving flags. expected_tool_calls carries an empty arguments object, and extra arguments the model volunteers are allowed, so the only assertion is that exactly one well-formed call to the right function came back on message.tool_calls. tool_choice is auto on purpose: deciding to call is part of the capability.
